cards.title: Toddlers deserve respect for their unique culture
cards.body: Small children have their own culture that adults should respect, not dismiss or join in with uninvited. Parents should recognize that toddlers appreciate their autonomy and boundaries.

cards.title: Don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for children
cards.body: Rockstar's 18-rated game is filled with explicit sex, drugs, and violence unsuitable for kids. Parents should be aware this is the most extreme content in gaming.

cards.title: Teachers need better knowledge of left-handedness
cards.body: Teachers play a crucial role in writing education but often lack understanding of left-handed children's specific needs. Proper training could significantly improve learning outcomes for these students.

cards.title: Managing when adult children pull away
cards.body: It's painful when adult children stop communicating, leaving parents with an empty feeling. There are helpful strategies to manage this distance and maintain connection.

cards.title: Family dynamics can worsen mental health problems
cards.body: Research shows ordinary family dynamics can shape depression and psychosis in children. Understanding these patterns helps parents support their children's mental health.

cards.title: Preparing kids for an AI-driven future
cards.body: Artificial intelligence is reshaping society, and parents need strategies to prepare children for this new reality. Early exposure and critical thinking skills are essential.

cards.title: Executive function and exploration in young learners
cards.body: Children's ability to explore and build—even when struggling academically—reveals important insights about learning and development. Hands-on projects can unlock potential in ways traditional methods might miss.

cards.title: Navigate generational differences during holidays
cards.body: Different generations bring conflicting expectations to family gatherings. Learning to bridge these gaps helps create meaningful traditions and stronger connections.

cards.title: Zines help children learn and explore creatively
cards.body: Simple to make and rich for learning, zines allow children to explore ideas personally and memorably. This hands-on approach turns learning into something worth sharing.
